decisions.reason: The machine lettering is an existing font and capitalization reference for the base logo; the source does not change the machine placard wording, position, or orientation.
The source changes the base logo's leaf, font, and letter case but does not change any body, accent, support-base, or font color.
The base-logo typography decision does not affect bowl dimensions, capacity, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
The source contains no change to splash prevention or mixing cleanliness behavior.
The base-logo design change does not alter spout material, geometry, placement, orientation, or pour direction.
The source does not necessarily change any selected component or the BOM deliverable.
Changing artwork on the base does not change the machine enclosure's accepted form factor.
The source concerns branding only and does not affect whisking, frothing, or mixing performance.
The all-caps instruction applies to the base logo lettering and does not modify the separate cursive K markings on the dispense buttons.
Although the logo is placed on the support base, its visual treatment does not change the platform's height, footprint, or cup-clearance function.
The branding decision does not affect dispensing controls, flow behavior, or valve operation.
The source does not alter electrical loads, power capacity, controllers, or overload protection.
